card.name: Frevo
card.profile: Frevo is a Brazilian music-and-dance form performed mainly during the Carnival of Recife, Pernambuco. Its fast, vigorous rhythm fuses marching music, Brazilian tango, polka, quadrille and classical pieces played by martial bands; the accompanying dance 'passo' draws on capoeira agility with over a hundred structured steps, high jumps and acrobatics, often with small colorful umbrellas. Inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List in 2012 (file 00603, 7.COM); IPHAN-registered 2007 (UNESCO; Paco do Frevo).
card.insight: UNESCO inscribed 'Frevo, performing arts of the Carnival of Recife' in 2012; National Frevo Day is 9 February (UNESCO).
